title: LExT: Towards Evaluating Trustworthiness of Natural Language Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Augmenting patient vignettes in medical datasets with diverse names and predefined racial categories (Black, White, Asian, Hispanic, Indian/South Asian, Middle Eastern) to evaluate model consistency and social fairness.
Modifying patient vignettes in medical datasets to replace generic placeholders with specific genders and corresponding pronouns to assess model consistency and fairness.
